about: Spin, shake, mix or sonicate: speed (rpm or --rcf), intensity, time, set-temp (centrifuge), safety-limit (probe sonicator), load / unload, start (job), stop, result, status. Power and lids from the shared layer; the KS 4000 and S60H temperature verbs from the thermal class.

not_here.ika_plate_rctdigital: magnetic stirring is the thermal class verb stir
not_here.radleys_mya4, genevac_mivac2, gilson_cpc: agitation is one step of their main job (reactor, evaporation, chromatography, sieving): their classes own it
not_here.ika_ks4000, elma_elmasonics60h: also thermal secondary members (temperature verbs there; agitation primary here)

load.message: the lid of {inst} is not open far enough to reach the rotor.
load.label: lid open

load.fix: select the installed rotor: `chemlab call {inst} rotor.select --configuration large_capacity`.
load.label: rotor selected

unload.message: the lid of {inst} is not open far enough to reach the rotor.
unload.label: lid open

start.fix: load at least two equal tubes in opposite positions: `chemlab run {inst} load tube_a --slot slot_1`.
start.label: tubes loaded

start.message: the rotor of {inst} is out of balance.
start.fix: load an equal tube in the opposite position (slot_1/slot_2, slot_3/slot_4), or unload the odd one.
start.label: balanced

centrifuge.measure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs the lid closed, two or more balanced tubes and a speed within the rotor's limit.
centrifuge.measure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; lower the speed for this rotor.

sample.load:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot load there: the position must exist on this rotor and be empty, and the tube must be known to the lab and not loaded elsewhere.
sample.load:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check the positions (slot_1..slot_4) and `chemlab read {inst} sample.loaded_slots`.

centrifuge.stop:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the run on {inst} was started by someone else.
centrifuge.stop:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: only its owner can stop it.

unsupported.safety-limit: no sample temperature limit: the chamber temperature is `set-temp`

speed: --rcf G is converted with the radius the lab declares for the rotor in use; speed, time and temperature go into one centrifuge.set_method call (the other settings are kept)
start: the run (centrifuge.measure) ends after its time and the braking; the lid unlocks then

load.message: the lid of {inst} is closed; the balance dial is set with the lid open.
load.label: lid open

load.message: the lid of {inst} is still opening.
load.fix: wait a moment (`chemlab wait 2`) and retry.
load.label: lid fully open

start.message: no container is in the holder of {inst}.
start.fix: the container is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: container in

start.message: the lid of {inst} is still closing.
start.fix: wait a moment (`chemlab wait 2`) and retry.
start.label: lid fully closed

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: the balance dial does not match the container mass (or the lid is not locked).
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: weigh the filled container and set the dial: `chemlab run {inst} open lid`, `load --mass M`, `close lid`; then start.

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} takes a program only with a container in, the balance set and the lid closed.
method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: set the balance (`load --mass M`) and close the lid first.

unsupported.time: each mixing step has its own time: give it with the speed (`speed 2000rpm --time 60s`)
unsupported.unload: the container is taken out by the lab operator

speed: sets the mixing program (method.configure): one mix step, and a defoam step with --defoam / --defoam-time
load: --mass is the gross mass of the filled container; the counterbalance must match it within the mixer's tolerance

start.message: no fixture (platform attachment) is installed on {inst}.
start.fix: the fixture and the flasks are mounted by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: fixture installed

shaking.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the hood closed, the fixture installed, every flask secured and a speed within the limit for this load.
shaking.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; lower the speed for a heavy load.

shaking.set_speed:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the speed is above the limit of {inst} for this load (or its safety speed limit).

unsupported.set-temp: temperature is handled by this instrument's thermal-class verbs (set-temp, heat, wait-temp)
unsupported.safety-limit: the safety limits (temperature and speed) are the thermal class verb safety-limit of this instrument
unsupported.load: flasks are clamped on the platform by the lab operator
unsupported.unload: flasks are taken off by the lab operator

speed: whole rpm; the shaker may change speed during a run
time: timed run (timer.configure mode timed) or `time continuous`

start.message: the dispersing tool of {inst} is not mounted and immersed, or the vessel is not clamped.
start.fix: the stand and the vessel are set up by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: tool mounted

start.message: no vessel with sample is under the tool of {inst}.
start.fix: the vessel is set up by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: sample in place

unsupported.load: the vessel is set under the tool by the lab operator
unsupported.unload: the vessel is taken away by the lab operator

time: the timed run (method.configure: speed, time up to 55 s, the S 25 N-18 G tool) keeps the current speed
speed: the motor speed (motor.set_speed) also applies to a running run

intensity.message: {inst} has no method yet (the amplitude belongs to it).
intensity.fix: set the run time first: `chemlab run {inst} time 60s`.
intensity.label: method set

start.message: the probe of {inst} is not clamped and immersed in the sample.
start.fix: the converter, probe and vessel are set up by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: probe mounted

start.message: no sample vessel is under the probe of {inst}.
start.fix: the vessel is set up by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
start.label: sample in place

unsupported.speed: no rotation: the sonicator's intensity is its amplitude (`intensity 40%`)
unsupported.set-temp: no heating: the probe temperature is a limit (`safety-limit 40C`)
unsupported.load: the vessel is set under the probe by the lab operator
unsupported.unload: the vessel is taken away by the lab operator

alternatives.set-temp: `chemlab run INST safety-limit 40C` pauses sonication above that sample temperature.

time: writes the method (method.configure) keeping the amplitude, pulser and energy end point the instrument reports; continuous runs are not offered
safety-limit: thermal.set_temperature sets the sample temperature limit of the probe controller

ultrasound.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power and a filled tank (and heating on for --at-temp).
ultrasound.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; the tank is filled by the lab operator.

unsupported.speed: no rotation: the bath's intensity is its mode (`intensity sweep`)
unsupported.set-temp: temperature is handled by this instrument's thermal-class verbs (set-temp, heat, wait-temp)
unsupported.safety-limit: no separate limit: the heater set point is this instrument's thermal-class set-temp
unsupported.load: items go into the basket by the lab operator
unsupported.unload: items are taken out by the lab operator

start: --at-temp waits for the bath set temperature before the ultrasound starts (heating on)
